scenes.setting: Glaint's study: Audrey clarifies the job — find a Beyonder who CAN kill Bakerland; 4000 pounds for the deed, 500 for the brokering, 200 even on failure
scenes.text_anchor: “What?” Fors touched her earlobes, wondering if she had heard wrongly.

scenes.setting: Mr. A's house at three o'clock: the hooded host accepts the assassination — for a High-Sequence formula (Unshadowed, Cataclysmic Interrer, Prophet or Manipulator) or 10,000 gold pounds
scenes.text_anchor: “Assassinate the Intis ambassador to the Loen Kingdom, Bakerland Jean Madan.”

scenes.setting: Evening handoff: Mr. A's terms passed to the familiar large golden retriever at a predetermined spot
scenes.text_anchor: the two of them met the familiar large golden retriever at a predetermined location

scenes.setting: Audrey, relieved it is only 10,000 pounds, plans a discreet 8000-pound loan and writes back: option two — 2000 in advance, 8000 on completion
scenes.text_anchor: When Audrey finished reading the note

scenes.setting: Tea-time report at 15 Minsk Street: the mistress is Erica Taylor of 126 New Year's Street; Mary will sponsor 'famous detective' Moriarty into the Quelaag Club to get the material evidence
